entry.summary: Andorra is outside Schengen but reached only through France or Spain, so a visitor needs Schengen entry to get there; re-entering Schengen counts again.
entry.next_check: Confirm Andorra's own entry rule and how border crossings are recorded under the Entry/Exit System.

seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: May, October and November. Driest: February, July and December. Hottest: August (17.0°C average). Coolest: February (1.0°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.
